findings.source_en: Just… leave us in peace already.
findings.issue: Addressee number flips. The villager speaks to Eredrim alone everywhere else in this memory - 'قلتُ ابتعد' and 'أحذّرك' in the Intro, and 'أرجوك... إردريم... اتركنا وشأننا' which is the same sentence in the singular. Only this row uses the plural اتركونا.

The namespace is FocusWeltcap - the speaker is inspecting a mushroom, not meat or a wound. اللحم in Arabic is animal flesh; the flesh of a fungus or fruit is اللُّبّ. As written the line reads as though someone is looking at red meat.
